category_title: Students with severe disabilities who use shouting and aggression to communicate basic needs
scenario_title: Interactive gaming and imitation with building blocks
minimal_context: The student is participating in an interactive gaming activity during school time, where the goal is to imitate the adult using building blocks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's play with the building blocks. Watch me put this block on top, and then you copy what I do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the blocks with a poor, stereotypical range of emotional expression, unable to execute the simple task of imitating the action.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come on, it's your turn. Pick up the block and put it here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows severely impaired nonverbal communication, making no attempt to interact with the blocks, but displays a predominant, stereotypical smile.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Since you aren't doing it, I am going to take these blocks away and we are going to change to a different game right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reacts to the sudden environmental change and stress by bursting into loud laughter as a defense mechanism, displaying tension in this inappropriate situation.)
